subject: SolvoHealth: PremiumSuite + Onboarding — exec exception request
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara@solvohealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PremiumSuite + onboarding — request to include pro services in list price

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo last week. SolvoHealth is excited about Redwood — our ops team is convinced this will cut query latency and embedding costs for our care-coordination product. We've reviewed the draft SOW and have two asks before we can move to procurement:

- Include PremiumSuite (12 months of premium support + 24/7 incident routing) as part of the onboarding bundle at no additional recurring cost for year one.
- A one-time onboarding credit or a 20% discount on the professional services line (we estimate roughly $120k in services).

Procurement is under time pressure for our Q4 launch — if we can get legal and finance-friendly terms this week, we can sign. I've attached the SOW we shared internally (SolvoHealth_SOW_v3.pdf).

Can you advise whether these concessions are doable or whether you need exec approval?

Best,
Tara Singh
Head of Operations, SolvoHealth
T: +1 415 555 0198

Subject: Re: PremiumSuite + onboarding — request to include pro services in list price

I'm looping in Deal Desk (Rishi) to evaluate the concession and route for approval. Rishi — quick summary: SolvoHealth requests PremiumSuite included in year 1 bundle and a 20% concession on ~$120k PS (they're targetting our concierge onboarding + 3 custom connectors). From: rishi.malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PremiumSuite + onboarding — request to include pro services in list price

Michael — reviewed the ask and SOW. Short answer: requires exec signoff for the full 20% + fully waived onboarding fee. Proposed approvable concession we can recommend to VP: 

- Pricing concession: 15% off the professional services line for year one (saves ~$18k on $120k).
- Premium support: include PremiumSuite at no additional recurring charge for first 12 months (we treat as a region-limited promotion).
- Onboarding fee: reduce to a fixed $10,000 one-time (instead of waiving entirely).
- Customer commitment: require a 24-month license term and a bumped minimum ARR for year one (this is already expected).

Rationale: this preserves gross margin, gives SolvoHealth the operational assurances they want, and keeps overall concession under our $75k executive threshold if we go with 15% + $10k fee. If they insist on 20% + waived onboarding, we need Marissa (VP Sales) or the CRO to sign off.

I've attached a quick pricing sheet with the math. If you want me to route for exec approval, I can prepare a short memo to Marissa with the recommended concession and the commercial impact.

Rgds,
Rishi Malhotra
Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Attachment: RDW_pricing_concession_20261006.xlsx
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: Exec approval required — SolvoHealth concession request (RDW-2026-1127)

Marissa — quick escalation. SolvoHealth (prospect turning into a commercial opportunity) is asking for two non-standard concessions as part of their onboarding: PremiumSuite included year one and a 20% PS discount (~$24k impact). They estimate $120k PS and expect expedited timeline to support a Q4 launch.

Key details:
- Proposed commercial structure (Deal Desk recommendation attached): 15% PS discount, PremiumSuite included for 12 months, $10k onboarding fee (instead of full waiver).
- Why this matters: SolvoHealth is high-visibility (national payer integrations), 24-month license commitment; if we close they are a strategic reference for payer vertical.
- Risk/impact: at 15% + $10k fee, total concession ~ $28k; at 20% + waived fee, concession exceeds $40k and requires VP/CRO signoff.
- Ask: please approve the Deal Desk recommendation, or indicate willingness to grant full 20% + waived onboarding. If approved, I'll send the revised SOW/DocuSign to Tara and instruct Legal to prioritize redlines.

I've attached the Deal Desk math and the current SOW. Rishi — please flag any risk items for Legal if Marissa approves.

Thanks for the quick read.
Michael
Head of GTM, Redwood Inference
(650) 555-0102

Attachments: RDW_pricing_concession_20261006.xlsx, SolvoHealth_SOW_v3.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: URGENT: Exec approval required — SolvoHealth concession request (RDW-2026-1127)

Thanks for the summary — I reviewed the Deal Desk recommendation and the customer profile. Approve with the following modifications and conditions: 

Approved concessions (final):
- PS discount: 12% off professional services line for year one (approves smaller concession than recommended to protect margin).
- Premium support: include PremiumSuite at no additional recurring charge for the first 12 months.
- Onboarding fee: set a one-time $10,000 onboarding fee (non-waivable).

Conditions:
- Customer must sign a 24-month license commitment and accept our standard data-retention and audit clauses (no special exceptions).
- Legal must approve any SOW redlines; no SLA deviations beyond what RDW standard premium support provides.
- Approval limited to this account only; do not use as a template for other deals.

If SolvoHealth refuses the 12%/10k combination and continues to insist on 20% + waived onboarding, escalate to CRO for final signoff.

Marissa
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0144

Tara — good news: our leadership approved a constrained concession to move this forward. Summary of agreed commercial terms (approved by Redwood VP):

- Professional services: 12% discount on year-one PS fees (applies to the services in SOW v3).
- Premium support: PremiumSuite included at no additional recurring charge for the first 12 months.
- Onboarding fee: $10,000 one-time fee (not waived).
- Customer commitment: 24-month license term required.

I've attached the revised SOW (SOW_SolvoHealth_revised_v4.pdf) that reflects the discount and updated onboarding fee. Please review and confirm. When you're ready, please sign via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/solvohealth/rdw-1127. Legal (contracts@solvohealth.com) — if you have redlines, please send to legal@redwood.com and I'll have Legal prioritize.

If these terms don't work for SolvoHealth, let me know immediately and I will escalate to CRO for final decision. Otherwise — excited to get this across the line and on our platform for Q4.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
